D-0001.title: The factory's code is a fresh public repository under a permissive licence

D-0002.title: The factory's own backlog is a separate public repository, public from day one

D-0003.title: The operator's configuration lives in the operator's home, and is multi-product from day one

D-0004.title: The earlier prototype is prior art to mine, not a base to build on

D-0005.title: The product-agnostic half of the first product's backlog moves to this record

D-0006.title: Real metrics from live products are what the factory optimises and proves itself against

D-0007.title: A hosted service on top is designed for, not built now

D-0008.title: The worker runtime is an interface, and a replay runtime ships beside the real one

D-0009.title: Worker pool backends are an interface; the API-key backend is a card, not 0.1 work

D-0010.title: Every record carries a schema version, and a command upgrades a backlog when it changes

D-0011.title: Issues on the code host become an inbox adapter in 0.2, not in 0.1

D-0012.title: An importer from existing issue trackers is a later card

D-0013.title: `asf doctor` ships in 0.1 as the one table that says what is wrong

D-0014.title: Three documentation surfaces, one audience each

D-0015.title: No telemetry leaves the operator's machine; a shared scorecard is opt-in and later

D-0016.title: Releases are semver, the changelog is generated from this record, and the version is stamped

D-0017.title: The project's full name appears once in every README, stamped table and version line

D-0018.title: The constitution is carried: ten directives in our words, mapped to the cards that enforce them

D-0019.title: Ids in this record are fresh, and a reference to another record carries its product prefix

D-0020.title: Numbered milestones give way to hotfix and feature packs once initial development ships

D-0021.title: The production probe signs in as a real customer through a mail alias, never through a bypass route

D-0022.title: Adopt proven methods from the prototype piecemeal; do not adopt its engine

D-0023.title: Split, never reopen: unproven acceptance on a closed Story becomes a new Story

D-0024.title: A named feature class can be carved out as an explicit exception to a default priority rule

D-0025.title: Memory is a defect: every remembered rule, step or fact becomes a card; only style stays memory

D-0026.title: Conflicts between rules and decisions are resolved by supersession first, a scan second, a human last

D-0027.title: Once a production probe runs, a human sign-off closes only customer-facing work

D-0028.title: The record is a repository of markdown cards with a generated index as the only machine-read artefact

D-0029.title: A memory-index source registered with a remote URL auto-pulls; a path-only source goes stale

D-0030.title: Automated end-to-end walks sign in through a minted link, never through a human relaying a mail

D-0031.title: Each worker account browses only through its own browser profile, from a session on that account

D-0032.title: Switching the active account moves every session sharing a configuration directory

D-0033.title: Features over process: merge on the fast required gates, never let slow jobs block

D-0034.title: Before fixing a CI red, read the failing job's own statement and the version of the script that ran

D-0035.title: The factory is measured only by the release speed of features that hold value for users

D-0036.title: Headless jobs run on dedicated worker accounts through per-account configuration folders

D-0037.title: A leaked credential is not rotated on the spot; every key is rotated once before the public release

D-0038.title: The permission classifier denies every write step of a production deploy by default

D-0039.title: Every agent account carries the repository grant, and each reuses one routine

D-0040.title: The factory is company-level and product-agnostic; only product assets carry a product's name

D-0041.title: A rate-limit percentage that dispatch depends on must exist in a file, not only on a status line

D-0042.title: Hotfix packs are available at any time; feature packs only open after the business trigger

D-0043.title: Use the long-window percentage for capacity planning; the reset countdown answers a different question

D-0044.title: When a long-lived branch conflicts with the main branch on a shared page, the main branch wins

D-0045.title: Install and upgrade: pipx from the repo tag; ~/.ASF holds data only; forward-only migrations; PATH-bound scheduler and hooks

D-0046.title: ASF fixes its own bugs through its own lane; direct fixes only while the lane itself is broken

D-0047.title: Done is proven by a named test or a typed ruling — never by a match or a session's opinion

D-0048.title: Worker failures loop back to their session at once; Bug cards are for ASF's own code defects

D-0049.title: ASF develops ASF autonomously: the factory answers its own groom and informs the operator

D-0050.title: Every saving is a card: spot it, cite the number, prove it on the scorecard, revert it if the number does not move

D-0051.title: A green run: the five conditions, computed and printed, not judged

D-0052.title: Adjudicate only after CORRECT fails twice on the same finding; adjudicate runs light unless S1
